propositions: The tickets branch must not trigger CI workflows per operator directive, enforced by adding 'tickets' to branches-ignore lists in all four push-triggered workflows
An enumerating test must verify that no workflow file in .github/workflows/ matches a push event to the tickets branch, preventing future regressions
Documentation must warn adopters that auto-pushing on every write causes CI saturation if workflows watch all branches, with guidance to use schedules instead

The runner starvation during the bug bash was caused by Gerrit Verified dispatch runs on main, not by tickets-branch pushes (which produce no runs because tickets is an orphan branch without a .github/ directory)
Schedule cron intervals and gerrit-verify.yaml dispatch-only configuration must remain unchanged after the branch filter additions
